auth.description: Central sign-in service: brokers Firebase, issues Caller Whale sessions and verifies second factors and human challenges.

variables.PORT: Runtime HTTP listening port; default 8101. Match Coolify's container port and private auth URLs when changing it.
variables.DATABASE_URL: Secret connection URI for auth's own database and sessions. Use its dedicated PostgreSQL login; changing the target changes the account/session store.
variables.AUTH_SIGNING_KEY: Secret Ed25519 signing key (base64 seed or PKCS#8). Keep stable; replacing it invalidates previously signed access tokens. Never put it in frontend settings.
variables.AUTH_PUBLIC_URL: Public auth base URL used for provider callbacks. Changing it requires matching Google/Apple callback registrations.
variables.AUTH_WEBSITE_URL: Return base URL for the legacy website sign-in target. Must be a trusted application origin; changing it changes where that OAuth handoff returns.
variables.AUTH_APP_URL: Return base URL for browser CRM sign-in. Does not replace the desktop app's restricted loopback return.
variables.AUTH_LANDING_URL: Public site's sign-in return base URL. Keep it aligned with the deployed landing website.
variables.AUTH_PUBLIC_SIGNUP: true lets anyone create an account (turn the human check on first); false closes public registration to invitation only.
variables.AUTH_DEV_TOKENS: Development-only confirmation tokens in API responses. Keep false in production; true exposes tokens intended only for local testing.
variables.AUTH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call auth. Include intended web and Tauri origins only; expanding this broadens cross-origin access.
variables.AUTHZ_URL: Private authorization service URL for the signed-in person's dashboard membership lookup. Keep this on the internal network.
variables.AUTHZ_TOKEN: Secret auth caller token matching authz's AUTHZ_TOKENS auth entry. Never expose it in frontend settings.
variables.AUTH_FIREBASE_API_KEY: Firebase project's Web API key, used only by auth's server-side broker. Not a service-account private key; changing it selects a different Firebase project.
variables.AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Optional direct Google OAuth Web client ID. With Firebase enabled, configured Firebase provider discovery can supply the broker flow instead.
variables.AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: Secret for the optional direct Google OAuth client. Must match its client ID; Firebase-managed broker flow does not require this direct-client override.
variables.AUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_ID: Optional direct Apple Services ID. Direct Apple flow also requires team ID, key ID and private key; Firebase broker availability depends on its own complete provider setup.
variables.AUTH_APPLE_TEAM_ID: Apple developer team ID for signing the optional direct-flow client secret. Must match the configured Apple key and Services ID.
variables.AUTH_APPLE_KEY_ID: Apple Sign in with Apple key identifier for the optional direct flow. Must match AUTH_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.
variables.AUTH_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY: Secret Apple .p8 signing-key text for the optional direct flow; literal backslash-n sequences become line breaks. Never expose it to clients.
variables.AUTH_NOTIFY_URL: Notification service private address (http://notifications:8102), never a public one. Set with AUTH_NOTIFY_TOKEN for email codes to be offered.
variables.AUTH_NOTIFY_TOKEN: Secret caller token matching auth's entry in notifications NOTIFY_TOKENS. Rotate both together; mismatches break authentication emails.
variables.AUTH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: Optional secret BotFather token enabling Telegram code delivery. Leave empty to disable this delivery method; never use a phone number as the token.
variables.AUTH_TELEGRAM_BOT_NAME: Telegram bot's public name used for account linking; must identify the bot whose token auth uses. Optional when Telegram is disabled.
variables.AUTH_TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Secret URL path component protecting the Telegram webhook. Coordinate rotation with Telegram's registered webhook URL.
variables.AUTH_ACCESS_MINUTES: Access-token lifetime in minutes; default 15. Changing it affects newly issued tokens and the frequency of refresh.
variables.AUTH_REFRESH_DAYS: Refresh-session lifetime in days; default 30. Changing it affects newly created session expiry, not the signing key.

gateway.description: Public API gateway: routes hostnames, verifies auth tokens, rate-limits requests and gates the private monitoring subpath.

variables.PORT: Gateway HTTP listen port; default 8100. Match Coolify's upstream container port.
variables.ROUTES: Comma-separated public-host=http(s)://private-upstream mappings. Changing this changes traffic destinations; do not expose internal-only services as public routes.
variables.CORE_HOST: Hostname in ROUTES that receives core-API access policy and private monitoring routing. Must match a configured route exactly.
variables.AUTH_JWKS_URL: Trusted auth public-key endpoint for token verification. Required when CORE_HOST is set; wrong keys block protected access.
variables.STAFF_REQUIRE_SECOND_FACTOR: Staff-route second-factor requirement; defaults on unless false. Keep true in production to protect admin/monitoring access.
variables.IP_PER_MINUTE: Positive per-IP requests-per-minute limit; default 600. Too low blocks legitimate shared-network users; too high weakens throttling.
variables.USER_PER_MINUTE: Positive per-authenticated-user requests-per-minute limit; default 1800. Changing it affects API throttling for signed-in users.
variables.MAX_BODY_MB: Positive maximum accepted request body size in MiB; default 64. Smaller limits can reject uploads; larger limits increase memory/traffic exposure.
variables.PROXY_HOPS: Trusted proxy-hop count for resolving the client IP; default 1. Match the actual proxy chain or IP rate limits can identify clients incorrectly.
variables.MONITORING_UPSTREAM: Private Grafana proxy HTTP origin, without path/query. Reached only through CORE_HOST /staff/monitoring; never give Grafana a direct public route.
variables.HUMAN_CHECK: true turns on the reCAPTCHA check in front of auth sign-up, sign-in, provider start and the website's waitlist and contact forms; needs every RECAPTCHA_* value and AUTH_HOST or the gateway will not start.
variables.AUTH_HOST: The ROUTES host that is the auth service. Only its real routes are answered; everything else is a plain Not found. Must be one of the ROUTES hosts.
variables.RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY: Public reCAPTCHA v3 key ID (starts with 6L). The sign-in pages receive it from auth's /v1/security answer through the gateway.
variables.RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY: Secret legacy reCAPTCHA key for the same key ID. Coolify only; never in GitHub, build variables or chat. Missing it with HUMAN_CHECK true prevents startup.
variables.RECAPTCHA_HOSTNAMES: Comma-separated sites a token may come from, as Google reports them; must match the key's domains. A wrong list refuses real people.
variables.RECAPTCHA_MIN_SCORE: Lowest Google score (0 bot to 1 human) accepted; default 0.5. Raise it if bots get through, lower it if real people are refused.
variables.HUMAN_PER_MINUTE: Guarded requests (sign-up, sign-in, provider start) a minute from one address, counted before Google is asked; default 30.
variables.SCAN_LIMIT: Requests for things that do not exist, from one address within SCAN_WINDOW_MINUTES, before that address is paused; default 20.
variables.SCAN_WINDOW_MINUTES: Minutes over which SCAN_LIMIT is counted; default 10.
variables.SCAN_PAUSE_MINUTES: Minutes an address stays paused after passing SCAN_LIMIT; default 15.

landing-web.description: Public static React site (home and account pages); signs people in through the auth service. The auth address is fixed at build time.

variables.VITE_CALLERWHALE_AUTH_URL: Build-time public auth service address embedded in the browser JavaScript, like https://auth.callerwhale.com. Rebuild to change; it is not a secret. Wrong value breaks every sign-in.
variables.VITE_CALLERWHALE_GATEWAY_URL: Public gateway address for the contact form. Available during build.

notifications.description: Central mail sender: only authorized backend callers can request messages; SMTP credentials stay here.

variables.PORT: Notification API HTTP listening port; default 8102. Match Coolify's private/public upstream configuration.
variables.NOTIFY_TOKENS: Secret caller=token pairs, 24+ characters each; only auth today. Match the caller's token; changing one side breaks that caller's mail.
variables.NOTIFY_SMTP_HOST: SMTP server hostname for delivery. Use the mail server's authenticated submission endpoint, not an inbound MX routing worker.
variables.NOTIFY_SMTP_PORT: SMTP submission port; default 587. Use STARTTLS 587 or implicit TLS 465 as supported by the server; do not use cleartext submission.
variables.NOTIFY_SMTP_USER: SMTP mailbox login; not a forwarding alias unless the mail server explicitly supports alias authentication. Must match the allowed sender.
variables.NOTIFY_SMTP_PASSWORD: Secret SMTP mailbox password. Rotate together with the mail server credential; incorrect value breaks every notification email.
variables.NOTIFY_MAIL_FROM: Email From header with Caller Whale display name and permitted sender mailbox. Must match mail-server sender authorization, not merely a forwarding destination.
variables.NOTIFY_CONTACT_TO: Team inbox the website's contact form writes to. Empty: the form answers 503. Only the team reads it; visitors never see it.
variables.NOTIFY_CONTACT_ORIGINS: Pages allowed to post the contact form from a browser, comma-separated origins like https://callerwhale.com. Others get no permission, so only the site can use it.

callerwhale-monitoring.description: Compose stack containing private grafana-proxy and Grafana; no direct public domain. Proxy enforces staff sessions; Grafana trusts only that proxy.

variables.PORT: Private Grafana proxy listen port; compose fixes it at 8120. Match the gateway's private monitoring upstream if changing it.
variables.GRAFANA_BASE_PATH: Protected browser subpath; only /staff/monitoring or empty is accepted. Match gateway routing and Grafana's root URL.
variables.GRAFANA_URL: Private Grafana HTTP origin reached by the proxy. Keep on the private monitoring network; not a browser-facing address.
variables.CALLERWHALE_CORE_API_URL: Trusted core API/gateway base URL used to recheck staff identity. If unreachable or refusing access, the proxy fails closed.
variables.CALLERWHALE_WEBSITE_URL: Trusted website origin allowed to frame Grafana and post the session handoff. Must match the website hosting Dashboard admin mode.
variables.ADMIN_GRAFANA_ROLE: Grafana role for system administrators: Viewer, Editor or Admin; default Editor. Platform owner remains Admin. Raising it grants more dashboard permissions.
variables.RECHECK_EVERY: Maximum interval between staff authorization rechecks; default 60s. Shorter intervals increase API traffic; revocation is checked on subsequent requests.
variables.SESSION_MAX_AGE: Absolute proxy session lifetime; default 1h. Expiry requires a new authorized sign-in even while the user remains active.
variables.IDLE_TIMEOUT: Inactivity limit for proxy sessions; default 10m. Idle sessions require fresh entry; this does not keep a disconnected browser authorized indefinitely.
variables.AUTH_WITHIN: Maximum age of the authentication used to enter monitoring; default 15m. Old sign-ins cannot create a fresh proxy session.
variables.COOKIE_SECURE: Secure session-cookie flag; default true. Keep true with HTTPS in production; false is only for local HTTP testing.
variables.GRAFANA_PUBLIC_URL: Browser root URL including the protected /staff/monitoring/ subpath. Compose maps it to GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL; never a direct public Grafana domain.
variables.GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Secret initial Grafana admin password, replacing the image default. Login form/basic auth remain disabled; changing env alone may not reset an existing stored admin password.
variables.GRAFANA_PLUGINS: Comma-separated Grafana plugin IDs to preinstall. Adding third-party plugins changes the dashboard code loaded at startup; review plugins before installing.
variables.GF_SERVER_SERVE_FROM_SUB_PATH: true serves Grafana under its configured root subpath. Must stay aligned with the gateway monitoring path.
variables.GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL: Browser-visible Grafana root, derived from GRAFANA_PUBLIC_URL. Keep the protected gateway URL/subpath or asset and redirect links break.
variables.GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Secret Grafana admin bootstrap password derived from GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Environment changes are not a password-reset mechanism for an initialized Grafana database.
variables.GF_SECURITY_COOKIE_SECURE: Grafana HTTPS-only cookies, derived from COOKIE_SECURE. Keep true for production HTTPS.
variables.GF_SECURITY_COOKIE_SAMESITE: Cookie SameSite policy; compose uses lax. Changing it can alter browser cookie behavior during navigation and embedded monitoring.
variables.GF_SECURITY_ALLOW_EMBEDDING: true permits rendering inside Dashboard admin mode. The Grafana proxy separately restricts allowed frame origins and staff sessions.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_ENABLED: true enables proxy-header authentication. Keep the proxy whitelist and disabled alternative logins intact to avoid impersonation paths.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_HEADER_NAME: Trusted username header, X-WEBAUTH-USER. Must match the proxy's emitted identity header.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_HEADER_PROPERTY: Proxy identity header is treated as username. Changing it changes how Grafana maps incoming identities to stored users.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_HEADERS: Mapping for Email, Name and Role from X-WEBAUTH headers. Must match the staff proxy; changing Role mapping affects dashboard privileges.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_AUTO_SIGN_UP: true creates Grafana profiles for identities accepted from the trusted proxy. This is not public Caller Whale account signup.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_WHITELIST: Only this proxy source IP may assert Grafana identity headers. Keep aligned with the proxy's fixed private-network address; widening it increases impersonation risk.
variables.GF_AUTH_PROXY_ENABLE_LOGIN_TOKEN: false avoids persistent Grafana proxy-login tokens. Access remains dependent on the staff proxy's session checks.
variables.GF_AUTH_DISABLE_LOGIN_FORM: true hides Grafana's local login form. Keep true; staff enter only through authenticated Dashboard admin mode.
variables.GF_AUTH_BASIC_ENABLED: false disables direct HTTP Basic authentication. Keep false to preserve the single staff-proxy entry path.
variables.GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED: false prevents anonymous Grafana access. Keep false in production.
variables.GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: false disables Grafana's own public registration. Trusted proxy profile creation is a separate controlled setting.
variables.GF_USERS_ALLOW_ORG_CREATE: false prevents Grafana users creating organizations. Keep false unless intentionally changing monitoring tenancy/permissions.
variables.GF_AUTH_SIGNOUT_REDIRECT_URL: Logout redirect to the protected proxy's /_callerwhale/logout endpoint. Must match its public monitoring subpath to end the proxy session.
variables.GF_ANALYTICS_REPORTING_ENABLED: false disables Grafana usage analytics reporting. Changing it enables outbound reporting; unrelated to Caller Whale operational metrics.
variables.GF_ANALYTICS_CHECK_FOR_UPDATES: false disables Grafana's automatic update checks. Container upgrades are handled through deployment instead.
variables.GF_SNAPSHOTS_EXTERNAL_ENABLED: false disables external snapshot publishing. Keep false to avoid exposing dashboard snapshots externally.
variables.GF_NEWS_NEWS_FEED_ENABLED: false disables Grafana's news feed. Does not affect dashboard data collection.
variables.GF_PLUGINS_PREINSTALL: Plugin IDs installed by Grafana, derived from GRAFANA_PLUGINS. Review before adding third-party code to the monitoring container.
variables.COOLIFY_NETWORK: External Docker network shared with the gateway; default coolify. Wrong network isolates monitoring from the gateway; never publish Grafana to compensate.
variables.SERVICE_FQDN_GRAFANA: Coolify-generated Grafana hostname metadata. The repository Compose does not consume this key; keep direct Grafana domain exposure disabled and use the protected gateway subpath.
variables.SERVICE_URL_GRAFANA: Coolify-generated Grafana service URL metadata. Not referenced by the repository Compose; it must not become a direct public monitoring entry point.
variables.SERVICE_FQDN_GRAFANA_3000: Coolify-generated hostname metadata for Grafana port 3000. The repository Compose does not consume it; do not attach a public Grafana domain.
variables.SERVICE_URL_GRAFANA_3000: Coolify-generated service URL metadata for port 3000. The repository Compose does not consume it; clients should use the protected gateway monitoring URL.
variables.SERVICE_PASSWORD_GRAFANA: Secret generated by Coolify for the monitoring resource. The repository Compose uses GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD instead; check the live Compose mapping before changing or deleting this key.
variables.GF_SERVER_DOMAIN: Grafana server-domain setting in the live inventory. Repository Compose uses an explicit GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL instead; keep browser links on the protected gateway origin.
variables.GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: Grafana bootstrap administrator username in the live inventory. Not set by repository Compose; changing it does not rename an existing stored account or enable direct login.

callerwhale-auth-postgres.description: Private PostgreSQL auth account/session store. Coolify manages database/login fields in General settings, not Environment Variables. Auth connects using its dedicated role through DATABASE_URL.

callerwhale-core-postgres.description: Private PostgreSQL CRM store. Coolify manages database/login fields in General settings. Core DATABASE_URL uses the restricted application role; DATABASE_SETUP_URL uses the schema owner for structure updates.

callerwhale-core-redis.description: Private Redis cache/invalidation broker for core-api and its worker. Password/user changes must match application consumers; PostgreSQL remains the primary data store.

variables.REDIS_USERNAME: Redis login name managed by Coolify; use the configured ACL identity when connecting. Keep core-api connection credentials aligned; the worker publisher currently accepts a password but no custom username.
variables.REDIS_PASSWORD: Secret Redis password managed by Coolify. Rotate together with core-api REDIS_URL and worker REDIS_PASSWORD; mismatches break caching/invalidation. Keep Redis private.

authz.description: Authorization service: decides what each person may do and which database rights each request runs under. No domain; called only by Caller Whale's services.

variables.PORT: HTTP port; default 8104. Match Coolify's container port and the callers' AUTHZ_URL.
variables.DATABASE_URL: Secret PostgreSQL URI of the existing private authz database. Include sslmode=require. The service creates its own authz_* tables.
variables.AUTHZ_SIGNING_KEY: Secret Ed25519 key (base64 PKCS#8 or 32-byte seed) that signs grants; `service new-key` prints one. Keep stable; empty uses a temporary key.
variables.AUTHZ_TOKENS: Secret caller tokens, caller=token comma-separated, 32+ characters each; auth reads account memberships, billing updates standing. Each caller gets only its own rights.
variables.AUTHZ_GRANT_SECONDS: How long a grant lasts, 5 to 600 seconds; default 60. Shorter means faster revocation and more calls.
variables.AUTHZ_REQUIRE_SECOND_STEP: Default true: roles that need the second step (owner, solo) must have passed it. false only for local testing.
variables.AUTHZ_STAFF_SECOND_STEP: Default true: Caller Whale's staff must have passed the second step. Keep true in production.
variables.AUTHZ_PLATFORM_OWNER: Optional. The person id (UUID, the sub of their sign-in token) of the Caller Whale owner. Applied at start only when Caller Whale has no owner yet; it never replaces one.
variables.AUTHZ_PLATFORM_COFOUNDER: Optional. Set once to the cofounder's Account ID (UUID). The first value is permanent across redeploys; changing this variable cannot replace them.

billing.description: Billing service: plans, subscriptions, payments, call minutes and desktop credits. No domain; the gateway routes its public paths.

variables.PORT: HTTP port; default 8103. Match Coolify's container port.
variables.DATABASE_URL: Secret PostgreSQL URI of billing's own database and login (callerwhale_billing). No other service uses it.
variables.BILLING_TOKENS: Secret caller tokens, caller=token comma-separated, 32+ characters each; empty today, nothing calls billing yet (core-api once rebuilt).
variables.PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Secret key of Paddle's notification destination for the billing webhook. Empty refuses every payment webhook.
variables.PADDLE_WEBHOOK_TOLERANCE_SECONDS: How old a signed webhook may be, 5 to 3600 seconds; default 300. Redeliveries are harmless: each event applies once.
variables.AUTHZ_URL: The authorization service's private address, like http://authz:8104, told of every standing change. Set with AUTHZ_TOKEN.
variables.AUTHZ_TOKEN: Secret billing token from authz's AUTHZ_TOKENS. Set with AUTHZ_URL.
